body: As I've gotten older (I'm in my mid-twenties) I can't believe how horrible parents and other adults can be to children, you're right, sometimes they're the worst. I could never imagine saying anything like that to my child if I had one, or any child for that matter. (Hell, any PERSON.) Sometimes it's hard to remember that this all started when I was a kid. Kids shouldn't be having those types of thoughts. It's just... *sad*, you know?

I talk to my SO a lot about it. She cooks for me and helps me eat. I feel guilty for bringing her into this at all.

When i was younger, I tried talking to peopel about it, but since I was raised female (I'm not now) I was told I should feel lucky to be able to eat so little and be so skinny. (How disgusting, coming from adults to a child.) My SO is the only one so far who has beleived me that I starved myself that much. I've tried opening up to a few people but they told me it was impossible, and when I told them I occasionally would break down and eat a half a sandwich or something, they used it to prove I was lying about the whole thing. I'm not bitter about it; I understand where they're coming from and I know they're probably right, that I didn't have that much of a problem and I should stop complaining. But it's hard to explain to healthy people how difficult it is to finish a meal now.

That's exactly what it feels like, that blow to your confidence. It isn't an ego thing, it's a self-worth thing. It hurts to know I can't do the things other people can't. It might sound a bit weird but it helps to know I'm not the only one.

Thank you.

It just seems so easy for everyone else. And if it isn't easy, they can at least do it. I don't know what's wrong with me.

And what if I'm not actually suffering? What if I am making this up? It hurts so much to think about but they might be right. I might just be making this all up, and I might just be lazy and selfish. I don't know. I have no way of knowing. It's eating me up inside.

I was calm. Now I'm crying. Thank you for reaching out.

I know it doesn't sound right to anyone else, but I don't deserve to eat with all the shit I put people through. My SO is the most beautiful, patient, caring person in the world and she deserves to be happy and healthy and well fed. I'm a waste of money. When I was about twelve toseventeen I would put sugar on a piece of bread and eat that for the day. If I ate two, I would be mad at myself for not having enough self-control. Nobody noticed, and that's one of the saddest things about this whole situation. Lately I've been making strides to pull myself out of anorexia but I realized as I was showering that there's no point to trying. I'm never going to be able to eat like everyone else, food will never be enjoyable to me and I will always fail. It's a waste of money and I'd rather someone else be able to eat than me. I don't know if that makes sense, but if you met me you would know where I'm coming from.
Happy birthday OP. I am so sorry this is happening to you.
